text: · {artists}

text: 数秒ごとに再試行しています。
context: Text shown in the server is away of the phone app.

text: 今すぐ試す
context: The label of a button in the server is away of the phone app.

text: 個人の評価
context: Heading above the stars somebody gives a title on the phone app.

text: {name} としてサインイン
context: The label of a button in the wall face in the way in of the phone app. {name} is filled in by the app.

text: サーバーが再起動中の可能性があります。Valence は数秒ごとに再試行します。引っ張って今すぐ再試行することもできます。
context: Text shown in the way in of the phone app.

text: パスキーでサインイン

text: ダウンロードを視聴
context: The label of a button in the way in of the phone app.

text: このスマートフォンの通知
context: A setting on the devices page of the phone app, and the label of its switch: whether this phone is woken when a request is ready, something new arrives or somebody invites you to watch.

text: リクエストの準備ができたとき、新しいものが届いたとき、または視聴に招待されたときに通知されます。
context: The description under the notifications setting on the devices page of the phone app.

text: サーバーの管理者はスマートフォンへの通知をオンにしていません。
context: Said in place of the notifications switch on the devices page of the phone app, where the server does not wake phones.

text: 音声と字幕
context: The button along the foot of the phone's video player that opens the audio and subtitle choices.

text: 明るさ
context: The slider up the side of the phone's video player that sets the screen's brightness.

context: The button that closes the audio and subtitles panel in the phone's video player.

text: エピソードを閉じる
context: The button that closes the episodes panel in the phone's video player.

text: 画質を閉じる
context: The button that closes the quality panel in the phone's video player.

text: 速度を閉じる
context: The button that closes the speed panel in the phone's video player.

text: 詳細情報を閉じる
context: The button that closes stats for nerds in the phone's video player.

text: コントロールをロック
context: The button in the phone's video player that locks its controls so a stray touch does nothing.

text: これには字幕がありません。
context: Under Subtitles in the phone's video player when the file has none.

text: 設定を閉じる
context: The label of a button in the choices in the watching of the phone app.

context: The detail in the watching of the phone app (from `theChoicesOn`).

text: 接続状況に応じて切り替わります
context: Beside Auto in the quality choices of the phone's video player: the phone moves between the copies the server keeps as the connection allows.

text: {A_STEP} 秒戻る
context: The label of a button in the controls in the watching of the phone app. {A_STEP} is filled in by the app.

text: {A_STEP} 秒進む
context: The label of a button in the controls in the watching of the phone app. {A_STEP} is filled in by the app.

context: The label of a button in the controls in the watching of the phone app.

text: 音声トラックは1つだけです。
context: Under Audio in the phone's video player when the file has only one soundtrack to choose.

text: コントロールのロックを解除
context: The one button drawn while the phone's video player's controls are locked.

text: {name} を使用
context: The label of a button in the server choice in the where is your valence of the phone app. {name} is filled in by the app.

text: そのアドレスのサーバーに接続できませんでした。
context: Shown in the where is your valence of the phone app.

text: サーバーのアドレス（例: valence.example.com）
context: Text shown in the where is your valence of the phone app.

text: サーバーに接続
context: Text shown in the where is your valence of the phone app.

text: Anna’s Archive は結果ではなく、ボット確認で応答しました。アカウントキーを追加すると、サインインした状態で検索できます。
context: Shown in the requests service when Anna’s Archive, a book indexer, answers a search with its bot check. Anna’s Archive is a name; keep it as it is.

text: Anna’s Archive からのダウンロードには、会員のアカウントキーが必要です。インデクサーの設定で追加してください。
context: Shown in the requests service when a book from Anna’s Archive can’t be downloaded because the indexer has no account key; only members can download without a browser.

text: この本が含まれるトレントは、Anna’s Archive でもう提供されていません。
context: Shown in the requests service when a book kept from Anna's Archive's index is in a bulk torrent Anna's Archive's list no longer has.

text: Anna’s Archive から本のダウンロードリンクが提供されませんでした（ステータス {status}）。アカウントの本日のダウンロード数を使い切った可能性があります。
context: Shown in the requests service when Anna’s Archive won’t give a fast download link for a book. {status} is the HTTP status it answered with.

text: Anna’s Archive の本ではありません。
context: Shown in the requests service when a release to be downloaded from Anna’s Archive doesn’t point at one of its books.

text: Anna’s Archive がアカウントキーを拒否しました。インデクサーの設定で確認してください。
context: Shown in the requests service when Anna’s Archive, a book indexer, doesn’t accept the secret key of the account Valence signs in with.

text: Anna’s Archive が応答せず、リダイレクトを繰り返しました。
context: Shown in the requests service when Anna’s Archive, a book indexer, redirects a request too many times.

text: データベースが応答していません
context: The problem in the app in the requests service.

text: リリースをダウンロードできませんでした。
context: Shown in the app in the requests service.

text: インデクサーを取り込めるのは Prowlarr だけです。
context: An error shown when asking to import indexers from Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr (from `createArrAppService`).

text: Prowlarr はインデクサーを管理するもので、リクエストは受け付けません。
context: An error shown when asking a Prowlarr for root folders and profiles a library could choose (from `createArrAppService`).

text: そのアドレスは {kind} ではなく {app} のものです。
context: Shown when testing a connected app whose address belongs to a different kind of app (from `createArrAppService`). {app} is what the app there calls itself, such as Sonarr; {kind} is the kind chosen, such as radarr.

text: アプリに接続できませんでした。
context: Shown in the connected apps in the requests admin, when testing Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr or Prowlarr fails for no reason it gave (from `createArrAppService`).

text: {name} が Valence で読み取れない形式で応答しました
context: Shown in the connected apps in the requests service (from `createArrCaller`), when Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr or Prowlarr answers with something unexpected. {name} is what the admin called the app.

text: {name} が HTTP {status} を返しました
context: Shown in the connected apps in the requests service (from `createArrCaller`). {name} is what the admin called the app; {status} is the HTTP status code.

text: {name} が HTTP {status} を返しました: {complaint}
context: Shown in the connected apps in the requests service (from `createArrCaller`). {name} is what the admin called the app; {status} is the HTTP status code; {complaint} is the app's own error message, untranslated.

text: {name} が APIキーを拒否しました
context: Shown in the connected apps (Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr) in the requests service (from `createArrCaller`). {name} is what the admin called the app.

text: {name} に {title} の取得を依頼しました。
context: Entry in a request's history when a release picked by hand is sent to the connected app it was handed to. {name} is the app, such as Sonarr; {title} is the release.

text: {name} に監視を依頼しました。
context: Entry in a request's history when Valence tells Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr to monitor it again. {name} is the app. Monitor is the apps' own word for following something.

text: {name} に再検索を依頼しました。
context: Entry in a request's history when Search missing asks the connected app it was handed to, such as Sonarr, to search again.

text: {name} に監視の停止を依頼しました。
context: Entry in a request's history when Valence tells Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr to stop monitoring it. {name} is the app.

text: {name} に {title} の停止を依頼しました。
context: Entry in a request's history when a download is stopped in the connected app. {name} is the app, such as Sonarr; {title} is the release.

text: {name} に {title} の再試行を依頼しました。
context: Entry in a request's history when a release is taken off the connected app's blocklist. {name} is the app; {title} is the release.

text: {name} でブロックされています。
context: Why a release is on a request's blocklist, where Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr gave no reason. {name} is the app.

text: {name} に送信しました。
context: An entry in a request's activity log, when Valence adds the request to a connected app (from `createHandOffWorker`). {name} is the app as the admin named it.

text: Lidarr に送信するための MusicBrainz ID がありません。
context: A request's problem, shown in the requests admin, when music handed to Lidarr lacks the id Lidarr finds it by (from `createLidarrHandOff`).

text: Radarr に送信するための TMDB ID がありません。
context: A request's problem, shown in the requests admin, when a film handed to Radarr lacks the catalogue id Radarr finds films by (from `createRadarrHandOff`).

text: Lidarr は MusicBrainz ID でそれを見つけられません。
context: A request's problem, shown in the requests admin, when Lidarr does not know the artist or album asked for (from `createLidarrHandOff`).

text: Lidarr にはメタデータプロファイルが必要です。ライブラリの設定で選択してください。
context: A request's problem, shown in the requests admin, when a music library handed to Lidarr has no metadata profile chosen (from `createLidarrHandOff`).

text: {name} が {folder} に取り込みました。
context: An entry in a request's activity log (from `createHandOffWorker`). {name} is the connected app as the admin named it; {folder} is the folder in the library.

text: {name} が {title} をダウンロード中です。
context: An entry in a request's activity log (from `createHandOffWorker`). {name} is the connected app (Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr) as the admin named it; {title} is the release it is downloading.

text: {name} はオフになっているか、リクエストを受け付けられません。
context: A request's problem, shown in the requests admin (from `createHandOffWorker`). {name} is the connected app as the admin named it.

text: {name} が追加できませんでした: {problem}
context: A request's problem, shown in the requests admin (from `createHandOffWorker`). {name} is the connected app as the admin named it; {problem} is why, itself a sentence.

text: Sonarr は TVDB ID または TMDB ID でそれを見つけられません。
context: A request's problem, shown in the requests admin, when Sonarr does not know the series asked for (from `createSonarrHandOff`).

text: 接続済みアプリのダウンロードには含まれていません。
context: Error when stopping a download for a request handed to Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr that the app no longer has.

text: 接続済みアプリに表示されたリリースの1つではありません。
context: Error when a release picked for a request handed to Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr wasn't one the app listed.

text: 接続済みアプリのブロックリストにありません。
context: Error when lifting a blocked release for a request handed to Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr that the app no longer has blocked.

text: 送信先の接続済みアプリは削除されました。
context: A request's problem, shown in the requests admin (from `createHandOffWorker`).

text: カスタムフォーマット {name} がチェックする内容の一部は Valence に対応するものがないため、それらのチェックを除いて取り込みました。
context: Shown beside a quality profile brought in from Radarr/Sonarr (from `profileOf`). {name} is the custom format's name; Valence profiles prefer or ban words.

text: カスタムフォーマット {name} がチェックする内容に対応するものが Valence にないため、取り込みませんでした。
context: Shown beside a quality profile brought in from Radarr/Sonarr (from `profileOf`). {name} is the custom format's name.

text: ホストが設定されていません。
context: Shown beside a download client that is not brought in from Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr because its settings name no host (from `plannedClientsOf`).

text: {library} を {app} に接続できなかったため、変更されていません。
context: Shown after bringing in a Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr setup (from `createArrImportService`). {library} is a Valence library, {app} the Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr it was to send its requests to.

text: {name} を追加できませんでした: {problem}
context: Shown after bringing in a Radarr/Sonarr setup (from `createArrImportService`). {name} is an indexer, {problem} why Valence refused it.

text: {name} を読み込めませんでした: {problem}
context: Shown after bringing in a Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr/Prowlarr/Overseerr setup (from `createArrImportService`). {name} is the app, {problem} why it could not be read.

text: その画質のいずれも Valence の画質と一致しないため、Valence の既定値を使用します。
context: Shown beside a quality profile brought in from Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr (from `profileOf`).

text: 優先、必須、禁止の単語のうち、最初の 50 件のみ取り込みました。
context: Shown beside a quality profile brought in from Radarr/Sonarr (from `profileOf`). Kinds are preferred, required and banned words.

text: リリースプロファイル {name} はタグ付きシリーズにのみ適用されるため、取り込みませんでした。
context: Shown beside a quality profile brought in from Sonarr (from `profileOf`). {name} is the release profile's name.

text: アプリのカテゴリーが競合しているか、Valence で許可されていない文字を含むため、一部のメディアの種類では Valence の既定のカテゴリーを使用します。
context: Shown beside a download client brought in from Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr (from `plannedClientsOf`). A category is the label a download is filed under in the client.

text: Valence はまだ {client} に対応していません。
context: Shown beside a download client that is not brought in from Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr (from `plannedClientsOf`). {client} is the kind of client, such as Deluge.

text: Valence はまだ {indexer} インデクサーに対応していません。
context: Shown beside an indexer that is not brought in from Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr (from `plannedIndexersOf`). {indexer} is the kind of indexer, such as AnimeTracker.

text: Valence には {qualities} に相当するものがないため、取り込みませんでした。
context: Shown beside a quality profile brought in from Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr (from `profileOf`). {qualities} lists quality names such as BR-DISK and Raw-HD.

text: .DownloadUri.Query.{key}
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`). {key} is filled in by the app.

text: サイトへのログインできませんでした。設定を確認してください。
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`).

text: 定義のダウンロードリンクのいずれも、トレントを返しませんでした

text: 定義は {method} でログインしますが、Valence はそれに対応していません
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`). {method} is filled in by the app.

context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`).

text: サイトが {status} を返しました
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`). {status} is filled in by the app.

text: サイトが、トレントではないダウンロードを返しました
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`).

text: サイトがログインを拒否しました。ユーザー名、パスワード、Cookie を確認してください。
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`).

text: サイトが検索を {redirectedTo} にリダイレクトしました
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`). {redirectedTo} is filled in by the app.

text: サイトのログインフォームに {key} に一致する入力欄がありません
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`). {key} is filled in by the app.

text: ログイン後も、サイトからログインを求められます。設定を確認してください。
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createCardigannIndexer`).

text: サイトのログインページに、{form} に一致するフォームがありません
context: Why an indexer could not log in to its site: the page had no login form where the indexer's definition said it would be. Shown with the indexer in the admin area. {form} is a CSS selector from the definition, such as form#login.

text: {what} に一致するものがありません
context: Why an indexer's search could not be read: part of the site's page its definition looks for was not there. Shown with the indexer in the admin area. {what} is what was looked for, from the definition.

text: いずれのケースにも一致するものがありません
context: Why an indexer's search could not be read: none of the cases its definition lists matched the site's page. Shown with the indexer in the admin area.

text: サイトが返した検索結果の JSON を読み取れませんでした
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `readSearchResults`).

text: サイトの検索結果に、定義が想定する行がありません
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `readSearchResults`).

text: Cloudflare のチェックを通過するためのブラウザを起動できませんでした
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createSiteClient`).

text: サイトに接続できませんでした
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createSiteClient`).

text: サイトが {timeoutSeconds} 秒以内に応答しませんでした
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createSiteClient`). {timeoutSeconds} is filled in by the app.

text: サイトは Cloudflare のブラウザチェックの背後にあり、このサービスにはそれを通過するブラウザがありません。
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createSiteClient`).

text: サイトのリダイレクトが多すぎます
context: Shown in the cardigann in the requests service (from `createSiteClient`).

text: {source} から定義をダウンロードできませんでした: {reason}
context: Why the catalogue of indexer site definitions could not be brought up to date. Shown on the admin area's indexers page. {source} is where they are fetched from; {reason} is why, which may be the system's own words and not translated.

text: ブラウザでサイトにサインインし、開発者ツールを開いて、ページのリクエストから Cookie ヘッダーをコピーしてください。値全体をここに貼り付けてください。
context: Shown in the definitions in the requests service (from `describeDefinition`).

text: このサイトの結果の一部には、Valence が認識しないカテゴリーがあるため、「その他」として表示されます。
context: Shown in the definitions in the requests service (from `describeDefinition`).

text: 一部のサイトは、Cookie を受け取ったブラウザに紐づけています。サイトがユーザーエージェントを求める場合は、ブラウザのユーザーエージェントもコピーしてください。
context: Shown in the definitions in the requests service (from `describeDefinition`).

text: このサイトは Cloudflare のブラウザチェックの背後にあります。リクエストサービスが独自のブラウザでチェックを通過するため、最初の検索には数秒余分にかかる場合があります。
context: Shown in the definitions in the requests service (from `describeDefinition`).

text: {name} が {status} を返しました
context: Why a download client could not be used: it answered with an HTTP error. Shown with the download client in the admin area's downloads panel. {name} is the download client's name; {status} is the HTTP status number.

text: {name} に接続できませんでした
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createClientCaller`). {name} is filled in by the app.

text: {name} が {waitSeconds} 秒以内に応答しませんでした
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createClientCaller`). {name} is filled in by the app; {waitSeconds} is filled in by the app.

text: {name} の回答: {said}
context: Why a download client refused something, followed by its own words, which are not translated. Shown in the admin area's downloads panel. {name} is the download client's name; {said} is what it said.

text: {name} は直接ダウンロードのみ受け付け、トレントや NZB は受け付けません
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service when a torrent or NZB is sent to the built-in direct download client. {name} is the client’s name.

text: 削除されたダウンロードクライアント
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createDownloadQueue`).

text: {clientName} が失敗を報告しています
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createDownloadQueue`). {clientName} is filled in by the app.

text: プログラム {program} が含まれていますが、映画、シリーズ、アルバム、本には含まれないはずのものです
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createDownloadQueue`). {program} is filled in by the app.

text: Valence が取り込めるものは含まれていません
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createDownloadQueue`).

text: {clientName} にもうありません
context: The problem in the downloads in the requests service (from `createDownloadQueue`). {clientName} is filled in by the app.

text: {name} は {protocol} のリリースをダウンロードできません
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createDownloadQueue`). {name} is filled in by the app; {protocol} is filled in by the app.

text: そのダウンロードクライアントは設定されていないか、オフになっています
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createDownloadQueue`).

text: それを見つけたインデクサーは削除されました
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createDownloadQueue`).

text: 現在の速度では、あと {wouldTake} かかります
context: The reason in the downloads in the requests service (from `judgeDownload`). {wouldTake} is filled in by the app.

text: ファイル一覧を受け取れず、開始されませんでした
context: The reason in the downloads in the requests service (from `judgeDownload`).

text: シーダーがおらず停止しました
context: The reason in the downloads in the requests service (from `judgeDownload`).

text: リンクが {host} に向いていましたが、プラグインにはそこからダウンロードする権限がありません。
context: Why a download from a plugin's download client failed while copying its files (from `createLinkFetcher`). {host} is the host.

text: {name} をダウンロードできませんでした: サービスが {status} を返しました。
context: Why a download from a plugin's download client failed while copying its files to this server (from `createLinkFetcher`). {name} is the file, {status} the HTTP status.

text: {name} が途中で何度も停止したため、Valence は取得を断念しました。
context: Why a download from a plugin's download client failed while copying its files to this server (from `createLinkFetcher`). {name} is the file.

text: {name} は、プラグインが示したサイズではありませんでした。
context: Why a download from a plugin's download client failed while copying its files to this server (from `createLinkFetcher`). {name} is the file.

text: {name} はダウンロードのフォルダーの外に保存されるため、拒否されました。
context: Why a download from a plugin's download client was refused (from `createLinkFetcher`). {name} is the file name the plugin gave.

text: ファイルをこのサーバーにコピーできませんでした。
context: Why a download from a plugin's download client failed while copying its files, when nothing more is known (from `createLinkFetcher`).

text: {folder} にこれらのファイルを保存する空きがありません。
context: Why a download from a plugin's download client failed before copying its files to this server (from `createLinkFetcher`). {folder} is the folder.

text: トレントクライアントが設定されておらず、オンにもなっていません
context: Why a release could not be sent to download: it is a torrent and no torrent download client is on. Shown when asking for a download in the admin area or a request.

text: Usenet クライアントが設定されておらず、オンにもなっていません
context: Why a release could not be sent to download: it is a usenet release and no usenet download client is on. Shown when asking for a download in the admin area or a request.

text: NZBGet で削除されました
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createNzbgetAdapter`).

text: {name} が応答しましたが、NZBGet ではありません
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createNzbgetAdapter`). {name} is filled in by the app.

text: NZBGet が完了できませんでした（{status}）
context: The problem in the downloads in the requests service (from `createNzbgetAdapter`). {status} is filled in by the app.

text: NZBGet が重複として削除しました
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createNzbgetAdapter`).

text: NZBGet が警告付きで完了しました（{status}）
context: The problem in the downloads in the requests service (from `createNzbgetAdapter`). {status} is filled in by the app.

text: {client} はダウンロードを一時停止または再開できません。
context: Why pausing or resuming a download was refused, for a download client a plugin provides (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} はこのダウンロードをダウンロードフォルダー内に保存できません。クライアントのフォルダーとカテゴリーを確認してください。
context: Why a finished download from a plugin's download client could not be copied: its folder would fall outside the client's download folder. {client} is the client's name.

text: {client} に接続できないか、{client} にそれがありません。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides refused or failed a download (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} はその中に映像を見つけられませんでした。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides refused or failed a download (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} にはダウンロードフォルダーがありません。設定で指定してください。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides cannot download anything: it was saved without a folder to save into. {client} is the client's name.

text: {client} はまだ準備できていません。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides would not hand over a download's files (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} は設定されていません。そのプラグインの設定で APIキーを確認してください。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides couldn't be used (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} はどのプラグインから提供されるか示していません。
context: Why a download client could not be used, when it is meant to come from a plugin but names none (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} にはそれが圧縮アーカイブとしてしかありません。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides refused or failed a download (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} が失敗したと報告しています。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides refused or failed a download, when it gave no reason Valence knows (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} は、アカウントが上限に達したと報告しています。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides refused or failed a download (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {client} が受け付けるサイズより大きいです。
context: Why a download client a plugin provides refused or failed a download (from `createPluginAdapter`). {client} is the download client's name.

text: {name} は、パスワードの誤入力が多すぎたため、このアドレスをブロックしました
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createQbittorrentAdapter`). {name} is filled in by the app.

text: {name} はカテゴリー {category} を作成できませんでした
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createQbittorrentAdapter`). {name} is filled in by the app; {category} is filled in by the app.

text: {name} がトレントを拒否しました
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createQbittorrentAdapter`). {name} is filled in by the app.

text: qBittorrent がファイルを見つけられません
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createQbittorrentAdapter`).

text: qBittorrent がこのトレントにエラーを報告しています
context: A problem shown for a download, in the downloads of the requests service (from `createQbittorrentAdapter`).

text: リリースは Valence が読み取れるトレントではありません
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createQbittorrentAdapter`).

text: コレクショントレントには、対象の本が含まれていません。
context: Shown in the requests service when a book from Anna's Archive is sent to qBittorrent but its collection torrent has no file at the path the index gave.

text: {name} が応答しましたが、SABnzbd ではありません
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createSabnzbdAdapter`). {name} is filled in by the app.

text: {name} が APIキーを拒否しました
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createSabnzbdAdapter`). {name} is filled in by the app.

text: SABnzbd が完了できませんでした
context: Shown in the downloads in the requests service (from `createSabnzbdAdapter`).

text: ログインするには、画像内の文字を入力してください
context: Shown in the captcha needed in the indexers in the requests service.

text: インデクサーがコードなしのエラーを返しました
context: Why an indexer refused a search, when it gave neither a reason nor an error number. Shown with the indexer in the admin area.

text: インデクサーがエラー {code} を返しました
context: Why an indexer refused a search, when it gave only an error number. Shown with the indexer in the admin area. {code} is the indexer's error number.

text: このインデクサーの定義はカタログにもうありません
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`).

text: インデクサーが {status} を返しました
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`). {status} is filled in by the app.

text: インデクサーがダウンロードに対して {status} を返しました
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`). {status} is filled in by the app.

text: インデクサーが {timeoutSeconds} 秒以内に応答しませんでした
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`). {timeoutSeconds} is filled in by the app.

text: インデクサーがリクエストの頻度を制限しています
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerClient`).

text: インデクサーの回答: {said}
context: Why an indexer refused a search, followed by the indexer's own words, which are not translated. Shown with the indexer in the admin area. {said} is what it said.

text: 障害中
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerService`).

text: 連続 {failures} 回失敗したため休止中: {problem}。失敗するたびに休止時間を延ばしながら、自動で再試行されます。
context: Why an indexer is skipped for now, shown on it in Requests › Indexers and in the requests health on the Overview. {failures} is a number of failed searches in a row; {problem} is the last failure's reason.

text: インデクサーに接続できませんでした
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `createIndexerService`).

text: カタログに {definition} という名前の定義がありません
context: Why an indexer could not be set up: the site definition it names is not in the catalogue of definitions. Shown when adding or testing an indexer in the admin area. {definition} is the definition's name.

text: インデクサーに定義が選択されていません
context: Why an indexer could not be set up: it was saved without saying which site definition to use. Shown when adding or testing an indexer in the admin area.

text: インデクサーが検索機能を報告しませんでした
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `readCapabilities`).

text: インデクサーの応答が Torznab でも Newznab でもありませんでした
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `readIndexerXml`).

text: インデクサーの検索への応答が、結果の一覧ではありませんでした
context: Shown in the indexers in the requests service (from `readReleases`).

text: {count} 枚のアルバムが公開され、必要とされています。
context: A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: an album by an artist asked for has been released and is now wanted. {count} is how many.

text: {count} 枚のアルバムが公開され、必要とされています。
context: A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: albums by an artist asked for have been released and are now wanted. {count} is how many.

text: {title} を選択しましたが、ダウンロードクライアントに送信できませんでした: {problem}
context: What was done with a search's releases, in the middle of a sentence: the best was picked but could not be sent to a download client. Fills {fetched} in a line of a request's history. {title} is the release's name; {problem} is why.

text: 取り込めませんでした: {reason}
context: Why a finished download could not be moved into the library. Shown with the request in the admin area and to whoever asked for it. {reason} is the reason, which may be the system's own words and not translated.

text: {count} 件のエピソードが公開され、必要とされています。
context: A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: an episode has been released and is now wanted. {count} is how many.

text: {count} 件のエピソードが公開され、必要とされています。
context: A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: episodes have been released and are now wanted. {count} is how many.

text: {count} 件のインデクサーで {found} 件見つかり、{fetched}
context: What a search found, in the middle of a sentence, when one indexer answered. Fills {outcome} in Searched for {what}: {outcome}. {found} is how many releases were found; {count} is how many indexers; {fetched} is what was done with them.

text: {count} 件のインデクサーで {found} 件見つかり、{fetched}
context: What a search found, in the middle of a sentence, when several indexers answered. Fills {outcome} in Searched for {what}: {outcome}. {found} is how many releases were found; {count} is how many indexers; {fetched} is what was done with them.

text: {indexer} が失敗しました: {problem}。
context: A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: an indexer failed during a search. {indexer} is the indexer's name; {problem} is why.

text: ダウンロードクライアントが保存先を報告していません
context: Why a finished download could not be filed: the download client did not say where the files are, and which client it was is not known. Shown with the download and the request in the admin area.

text: ファイルに、まだ必要なエピソードは含まれていません
context: Why a release is refused for a series request: once its files were seen, none of them is an episode the request still waits for. Shown in the media requests and on the downloads page in the requests service.

text: ファイルに、まだ必要なものは含まれていません
context: Why a release is refused for a film, music or book request: once its files were seen, they did not hold what the request still waits for. Shown in the media requests in the requests service.

text: 含まれるものはすべてライブラリにあるか、ダウンロード中です
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`).

text: 以前に失敗しました: {reason}
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`). {reason} is filled in by the app.

text: 別のリクエストのためにすでにダウンロード中です
context: Why a release was refused for a request: the same release, by name or torrent hash, is already in the download queue, sent for a different request. Shown beside the release in interactive search.

text: ライブラリにあるものより良くはありません
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`).

text: 名前がこの作品と一致しません
context: Why a release in interactive search can't be chosen automatically: its name doesn't say it's for the requested title (from `judgeForRequest`).

text: 保持している {held} 件のエピソードのうち、必要なのは {wanted} 件だけです
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`). {wanted} is filled in by the app; {held} is filled in by the app.

text: 保持している {held} シーズンのうち、必要なのは {wanted} シーズンだけです
context: Why a pack of several seasons was refused for a request, shown beside the release in interactive search and in a request's activity. {wanted} and {held} are numbers of seasons.

text: どのエピソードですか？ 番号が複数の意味を持つ可能性があります
context: Why a release of an anime was held back: the way it numbers its episodes could mean different episodes of the show, so somebody has to say which. Shown in the list of releases found for a request.

text: インデクサーがオンになっていません
context: What a search found, in the middle of a sentence: nothing, because no indexer is on. Fills {outcome} in Searched for {what}: {outcome}.

text: 1 件の結果が一致しませんでした
context: What was done with a search's releases, in the middle of a sentence: one was found, and it was not for this request. Fills {fetched} or {said} in a line of a request's history. {count} is how many were found.

text: {count} 件の結果のいずれも一致しませんでした
context: What was done with a search’s releases, in the middle of a sentence: several were found, none for this request. Fills {fetched} or {said} in a line of a request’s history. {count} is how many were found.

text: {runningAs} として実行されているリクエストサービスには、{folder} への書き込み権限がありません。PUID と PGID を、メディアフォルダーの所有者に設定してください。
context: Shown in the not allowed there in the media requests in the requests service. {runningAs} is filled in by the app; {folder} is filled in by the app.

text: {title} を取り込めませんでした: {problem}。
context: A line in a request's history, shown in the request's details in the admin area: a finished download could not be moved into the library. {title} is the download's name; {problem} is why.

text: このユーザー
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `placeFile`).

text: ユーザー {user} とグループ {group}
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `placeFile`). {user} is filled in by the app; {group} is filled in by the app.

text: そのリリースには、このリクエストが待っているアルバムは含まれていません
context: Why a release picked by hand for a music request was not sent: nothing in it is an album the request still wants. Shown when picking a release by hand for a request.

text: そのリリースには、このリクエストが待っているエピソードは含まれていません
context: Why a release picked by hand for a series request was not sent: nothing in it is an episode the request still wants. Shown when picking a release by hand for a request.

text: 最新のリリースの中で、{said}。
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {said} is filled in by the app.

text: {forIt} 件の一致から最良の {title} を選択しました
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {title} is filled in by the app; {forIt} is filled in by the app.

text: {title} から取り込みました。同じシリーズの別の本のために取得したシリーズ全体のパックからです
context: Said in a book request's activity when a whole-series pack fetched for another book of the same series also held this book. {title} is the pack's name.

text: {total} トラックのうち {filed} トラックしか届きませんでした。完全版を探しています。
context: Shown on an album of a music request that was filed with fewer tracks than its longest edition has. {filed} and {total} are numbers of tracks.

text: {title} から {size} を {folder} に取り込みました。
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {size} is filled in by the app; {title} is filled in by the app; {folder} is filled in by the app.

text: {forIt} 件が一致しましたが、どれも受け入れられませんでした。最良の {title} は {why} のため却下されました。
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`). {forIt} is filled in by the app; {title} is filled in by the app; {why} is filled in by the app.

text: {group} のこの番組のリリースは、今後同じ方法で読み取られます。
context: Said in a request's activity when an admin answered which episodes an anime release holds and asked for the answer to be remembered for its release group. {group} is the release group's name.

text: 誰かがエピソードを指定するまで、リリース 1 件を保留しました
context: Said in a request's activity when an anime release's numbering could mean more than one set of episodes, so it waits for an admin to answer on the title's page. Counted by releases held.

text: 誰かがエピソードを指定するまで、リリース {count} 件を保留しました
context: Said in a request's activity when anime releases' numbering could mean more than one set of episodes, so they wait for an admin to answer on the title's page. {count} is how many releases are held.

text: リクエストされたものは含まれていませんでした
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: 省略版です: {have}（必要 {want}）。
context: Why an audiobook download was refused and blocklisted: it is much shorter than the book's full listening time. {have} and {want} are lengths, such as 3 h 50 min.

text: このリクエストは接続済みアプリに送信され、そのアプリがリリースを選択します。
context: An error shown when an admin picks a release by hand for a request its library hands to Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: パート {parts} が不足しています
context: Why an audiobook download was refused: its files are numbered as parts, and one is missing. Shown in the request's activity and the list of releases it won't try again. {parts} is the missing part's number.

text: {count} パートが不足しています: {parts}
context: Why an audiobook download was refused: its files are numbered as parts, and some are missing. Shown in the request's activity and the list of releases it won't try again. {count} is how many; {parts} lists their numbers, such as 3, 7.

text: 選択されたリリースのファイルには含まれていません
context: Why an episode is wanted again: the release chosen for it turned out, once its files were listed, not to hold that episode. Shown on the episode in a request.

text: 公開済みで、必要とされています。
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: 完了前にダウンロードが削除されたため、再度リクエスト対象になりました。
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: {title} のファイルには、まだ必要な別のエピソードが含まれているため、それもダウンロードします
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out to hold an episode the request still waits for beyond those it was chosen for. {title} is the release's name.

text: {title} のファイルには、まだ必要なエピソードがさらに {count} 件含まれているため、それらもダウンロードします
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out to hold episodes the request still waits for beyond those it was chosen for. {title} is the release's name and {count} how many episodes.

text: {title} には、選択されたエピソードが含まれていないため、そのエピソードを再度リクエスト対象にします
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out not to hold an episode its name suggested, so that episode is searched for again. {title} is the release's name.

text: {title} には、選択されたエピソードが {count} 件含まれていないため、それらを再度リクエスト対象にします
context: Said in a request's activity when a release's files turn out not to hold episodes its name suggested, so those episodes are searched for again. {title} is the release's name and {count} how many episodes.

text: 名前から何であるかが分かりません
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `createRequestWorker`).

text: トラックが不足していました。
context: Why a release is on a music request's blocklist: the album it held had fewer tracks than its longest edition.

text: ダウンロードしたファイルに含まれていませんでした

context: Shown when no administrator has edited a title. On the History tab of a title in the admin area (from `TitleHistory`).

text: 取得中
context: Said briefly after an admin answered which episodes an anime release holds, and it was sent to be downloaded.

text: 最有力
context: A badge on the answer Valence thinks most likely, on a “Which episode is this?” card on an anime's page in Requests › Catalogue.

text: 番号が複数のエピソードの組み合わせを示す可能性があります。どちらかを選ぶと取得されます。
context: The text of a “Which episode is this?” card on an anime's page in Requests › Catalogue, above a button for each way the release could be read.

text: 取得しません
context: Said briefly after an admin chose not to fetch an anime release Valence was unsure about.

text: 取得しない

text: 確認するリリース

text: 今後は {group} のこの作品のリリースを、この方法で読み取る

text: どのエピソードですか？
context: The heading of a card on an anime's page in Requests › Catalogue, about a release whose numbering could mean different episodes, so an admin can say which.

text: 同じ作品世界の作品
context: A heading on an anime's page in Requests › Catalogue, above the films that belong to the show.

text: AniList のエントリー
context: A choice of how an anime's cours are worked out, on its page in Requests › Catalogue: one cour per entry AniList has for the show.

text: このアニメのクールを再計算しました

text: このアニメのリリースグループを変更しました
context: Said briefly after an admin changed the release group an anime is kept to.

text: 各クールは以下の行になり、リクエストと検索の対象が表示されます。
context: The description under the Cours choice on an anime's page in Requests › Catalogue, which decides how the show's episodes are divided into cours.

text: このグループのリリースは、ほかのものより優先されます。どのグループでも構わない場合は空欄のままにしてください。
context: The description under the Release group field on an anime's page in Requests › Catalogue.

text: プロフィールと同じ（{speech}）
context: The first choice of speech on an anime's page in Requests › Catalogue: whatever its quality profile says. {speech} is the profile's choice, such as Subtitles.

text: 別名
context: A heading on an anime's page in Requests › Catalogue, above the show's names in English, romaji and Japanese, which it's searched for by on indexers.

text: このアニメの音声を変更しました
context: Said briefly after an admin changed whether an anime is fetched with subtitles, dubbed or in dual audio.

text: カタログのシーズン
context: A choice of how an anime's cours are worked out, on its page in Requests › Catalogue: one cour per season the catalogue (TMDB) lists.

text: カタログの「{name}」エピソードグループ
context: A choice of how an anime's cours are worked out, on its page in Requests › Catalogue: one cour per part of one of the catalogue's (TMDB's) episode groups. {name} is the group's name as TMDB gives it.

text: 自動で計算
context: A choice of how an anime's cours are worked out, on its page in Requests › Catalogue: Valence decides from the catalogue's seasons, its episode groups and AniList.

text: 最初のリクエスト

text: ほかに{count}人が希望しています
context: Shown on hover and read aloud for the circle after the faces of the people who also asked for a title, on its admin page, when there are too many to draw them all. {count} is how many are left out.

text: ほかに{count}人が希望しています
context: Shown on hover and read aloud for the circle after the faces of the people who also asked for a title, on its admin page, when there are too many to draw them all. {count} is how many are left out.

text: {count} 人が希望しています
context: The heading of the list of everybody who asked for a title, at the top of its page in the admin area. {count} is how many.

text: {count} 人が希望しています
context: The heading of the list of everybody who asked for a title, at the top of its page in the admin area. {count} is how many.

text: 希望しているすべての人
context: The label of the control at the top of a title's page in the admin area that opens the list of everybody who asked for it.

text: 自動
context: How a title is fetched: Valence searches for it by itself. Shown on a title’s page in the admin Catalogue.

text: カタログに戻る
context: A button shown when a title opened in the admin Catalogue is no longer there.

text: {count} パート、{stands}
context: What an audiobook's bar of parts says to somebody who can't see it, on a book's page in Requests › Catalogue. {stands} is where it stands, such as In the library.

text: {count} パート、{stands}
context: What an audiobook's bar of parts says to somebody who can't see it, on a book's page in Requests › Catalogue. {count} is how many parts; {stands} is where it stands, such as In the library.

text: 却下…
context: A button on a title’s page that declines its request, after asking for an optional note.

text: 以前に一時停止されたため、中止されることはありません
context: On a download on a title's page in the admin area, when somebody paused it in the download client and later resumed it. Valence no longer replaces it with another release however slow it is.

text: 手動で選択
context: On a download on a title's page in the admin area, when the release was picked by hand in interactive search rather than by Valence.

text: ダウンロードを停止…
context: The tooltip of the cross that stops one download on a title’s page.

text: ファイル名
context: A column in the episode table on a show’s page in the admin Catalogue.

text: 取得
context: A label on a title’s page: whether it is searched for automatically or only fetched when a release is picked by hand.

text: {name} をフォロー中
context: Said once a title, season or album is followed. {name} is what.

text: 両方のバージョンを取得します
context: Toast after the operator chooses to keep both versions of a film, the one being fetched and the higher-quality one asked for.

text: {name} が処理
context: Accessible name of the note on an admin title page whose library hands requests to a connected app such as Sonarr. {name} is the app's name.

text: {name} が処理します。この作品を検索、ダウンロード、取り込みし、Valence は {name} の動作を追跡します。不足分の検索では、{name} に再検索を依頼します。
context: Note on an admin title page whose library hands requests to a connected app. {name} is the app's name, such as Sonarr.

text: {name} で開く
context: Link on the handed-off note to the title's page in the connected app, such as Sonarr.

text: {height}p
context: A resolution, such as 1080p. {height} is the picture’s height in pixels.

text: {total} 件中 {held} 件
context: How many episodes or albums of a title are in the library, on its page. {held} is how many are; {total} is how many there are.

text: ライブラリの設定どおり
context: On a title's page, the choice that searches it on the indexers its library uses rather than ones chosen for it.

text: インデクサーを変更しました
context: A notice after the indexers a title is searched on were changed.

text: このライブラリでは使用しない
context: Beside an indexer on a title's page: its library does not search this indexer unless it is chosen here.

text: この作品は、ライブラリが使用しているインデクサーで検索されます。ここで一部を選ぶと、それらだけで検索します。
context: On a title's page, above the choice of indexers it is searched on.

text: このライブラリで使用
context: Beside an indexer on a title's page: its library searches this indexer anyway.

text: 手動検索
context: A button on a title’s page that lists every release the indexers have for it, to pick one by hand.

text: {title} の手動検索
context: The title of the interactive search dialog. {title} is what is searched for.

text: {title}、{scope} の手動検索
context: The title of the interactive search dialog when it is narrowed to one season or episode. {title} is the show; {scope} is the season or episode, such as Season 1 or S01E03.

text: シーズン全体のリリースのみ表示されます。選ぶと、そのために現在ダウンロード中のものは置き換えられます。
context: Under the title of the interactive search dialog when it is opened for a whole season, which shows only season packs.

text: リリースを選ぶと、同じエピソードのために現在ダウンロード中のものは停止され、ブロックされます。
context: The explanation under the title of the interactive search dialog.

text: {name} の手動検索
context: The label of the button on a season or episode on a title's page in the admin area that opens interactive search for it. {name} is the season or episode, such as Season 1 or S01E03.

text: {total} トラックのうち {filed} トラック
context: Under an album on a music request's page, when fewer of its tracks came than its longest edition has. {filed} and {total} are numbers.

text: {quality} で所有しています。ロスレスを探しています
context: Under an album on a music request's page, when the library holds it lossy and the request upgrades lossy albums to lossless. {quality} is a quality, such as MP3 320.

text: 画質、ライブラリ、シーズン
context: The description of Edit in the menu on a title’s page.

text: {profile} を維持
context: Toast after the operator keeps a request at its profile, turning down a higher one somebody asked for.

text: マグネットリンクを追加

context: The example shown in an empty magnet link field. Keep the magnet:?xt=urn:btih: part as it is.

text: マグネットリンクをダウンロード中

context: Under the name given to a pasted magnet link.

text: マグネットリンク
context: The label of the field a magnet link is pasted into.

context: A problem with a pasted magnet link: it is not one, or it carries no name and none was given.

text: 含まれる内容
context: The label of the field naming a pasted magnet link the way a release is named.

text: ライブラリにあるものとしてマーク
context: A menu item on a title’s page for something added to the library by hand.

text: {title} をライブラリにあるものとしてマークしました
context: Said after Mark as in the library. {title} is the title.

text: {minutes} 分
context: How long a film runs, on its page. {minutes} is how many minutes.

text: 選択するナレーション
context: The name, for screen readers, of the card on a book's page asking which narration of its audiobook to fetch.

text: 選択されたナレーションを取得中。
context: Shown once a narration of an audiobook was chosen on a book's page.

text: すべて
context: A button on the card asking which narration of an audiobook to fetch, fetching every narration listed.

text: {title} のどのナレーションですか？
context: Asked on a book's page in the admin area when its audiobook is out in more than one narration and none has been chosen. {title} is the book.

text: {title} の新しいシーズンは、放送され次第取得されます
context: Shown on a show's admin page once 'Get new seasons as they come' is turned on. {title} is the show.

text: {title} の新しいシーズンは、もう取得されません
context: Shown on a show's admin page once 'Get new seasons as they come' is turned off. {title} is the show.

text: {name} のフォローを解除しました
context: Said once a season or album is no longer followed. {name} is what.

text: ディスク上
context: The heading of the card on a title’s page about its files.

text: 選んだリリースのみ
context: How a title is fetched: only what an admin picks by hand. Shown on a title’s page in the admin Catalogue.

text: 高画質のリクエスト
context: Accessible name of the notice on an admin title page when somebody asked for the title at a higher quality profile.
